title: autoformat workflow: git commit author identity comes from github.event.issue.user, not API lookups
answers: Autoformat commits show the wrong author or a bot name when a PR is auto-formatted from a comment
How does the autoformat workflow pick the git user.name and user.email for its fix commit?
Why does the autoformat job no longer call gh pr view or gh api users to resolve the author?
Where is the mlflow-app[bot] attribution set for autoformat commits?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/autoformat.yml, job step "Configure git" (runs before the autoformat commit is pushed). It sets git user.name and user.email for commits made when a maintainer's comment triggers formatting on a PR.
Rule: Take the identity from the workflow event payload: AUTHOR_LOGIN, AUTHOR_ID and AUTHOR_TYPE env vars read from github.event.issue.user.{login,id,type}. Do not use gh pr view or gh api users/<login> to look these up; those calls need a token and an extra network round trip. If AUTHOR_TYPE is "Bot", use LOGIN=mlflow-app[bot] and the hardcoded verified ID 191841109; otherwise use the login and id from the payload. The email is always the noreply form ${ID}+${LOGIN}@users.noreply.github.com.
Constraints: Applies only to this step's identity logic. If the bot account ID changes, the hardcoded 191841109 must be updated by hand. The step no longer needs GH_TOKEN, PR_NUMBER or REPO env vars, so do not re-add them for identity lookup.
applies: Autoformat GitHub Actions workflow, commit author identity for comment-triggered fixes.
says: Automated formatting commits on pull requests show an incorrect author or bot account.
Comment-triggered style fixes should attribute commits to the maintainer who requested them.
Code formatting commits display wrong username and email address in pull request history.
Ensure automated cleanup commits correctly credit the user commenting on the pull request.
search: In .github/workflows/autoformat.yml, git commit author identity for comment-triggered fixes is derived directly from github.event.issue.user rather than GitHub API calls. It sets AUTHOR_LOGIN, AUTHOR_ID, and AUTHOR_TYPE from the event payload, mapping bots to mlflow-app[bot] with ID 191841109 and constructing noreply emails without needing GH_TOKEN or gh CLI queries. Applies exclusively to the Configure git step in the autoformat workflow, requiring manual updates if the bot account ID changes.
